title: Adoption of green technologies, smart energy use, and public environmental awareness: A SEM‐ANN model for sustainable energy transition
content:
Abstract

This study investigates the key determinants of sustainable energy transition, focusing on green technology adoption, smart energy use, public environmental awareness, and energy efficiency. Using survey data from 372 residential energy consumers in Pakistan, the research applies Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) to assess the direct and indirect relationships among these variables and incorporates Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) to validate and rank their predictive importance. The results show that energy efficiency plays a central mediating role and significantly enhances the impact of technological and behavioral factors on sustainable energy transition. ANN findings further identify energy efficiency as the most influential predictor. The study also reveals a negative moderating effect of government policy support on the relationship between energy efficiency and sustainable energy transition, suggesting the need for better-aligned policy frameworks. These findings provide theoretical contributions to sustainability modeling and offer practical insights for policymakers aiming to design more effective energy transition strategies.
